chunks: And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) has said: 'The maternal uncle is an inheritor of the one who has no inheritor for him.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits if a person has no other relatives in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the maternal uncle (al-khal) as the heir in the absence of closer relatives, reflecting the Shia juristic view that maternal kin can inherit when the paternal line is exhausted. It underscores the significance of the 'asabah' (residuary heirs) category, where the uncle steps in to preserve the estate within the extended family structure, a ruling supported by the consensus of major Shia scholars.
